pick.name: Together AI fine-tuning
pick.what: Managed supervised and DPO fine-tuning of open models, per-token billing
pick.why: No GPU ops: Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen3.5 0.8B-9B SFT at $0.34 per 1M training tokens; Gemma 4 26B/31B $1.05/M; Llama 3.3 70B $2.03/M
pick.free_limits: No free credits stated. Every job has a per-model minimum charge: $4 for most models up to 70B, rising to $6-$60 for the largest (e.g. Kimi K2.6 $60). A second table lists slightly higher rates ($0.38/M small) without labelling LoRA vs full.

best_free.name: Unsloth on free Colab/Kaggle GPUs
best_free.what: Fast LoRA/QLoRA/GRPO training with GGUF export; free Colab and Kaggle notebooks; optional Studio UI (AGPL-3.0)
best_free.why: Fine-tune 1-8B models free on borrowed GPUs then export GGUF for llama.rn/Ollama
best_free.free_limits: Library free (Apache-2.0). On free Colab/Kaggle: dynamic undisclosed limits, ~12h sessions, GPU not guaranteed; Colab terms prohibit hosting web services. Do not put regulated data in free notebooks.
best_free.license: Core Apache-2.0; Unsloth Studio UI is AGPL-3.0
best_free.platforms: web (Colab/Kaggle notebooks); local on Linux, Windows (WSL or desktop app), macOS

alts.name: Modal (pay-per-second GPUs)
alts.why: Scriptable, reproducible runs when Colab limits bite
alts.free_limits: Starter $0/mo includes $30 free compute/mo; T4 $0.000164/s, L4 $0.000222/s, A10 $0.000306/s; startup credits program

candidates.name: Together AI
candidates.verdict: Pick: managed, cheap, no GPU ops

candidates.name: Modal + Unsloth/TRL
candidates.verdict: Best for repeatable runs; $30/mo free compute on Starter

candidates.name: MLX LM LoRA (Apple) / local NVIDIA
candidates.verdict: Free if you already own the hardware

decision: Fine-tune only after evals show prompting and RAG are failing. Together AI is the lowest-friction managed route; Unsloth on free Colab/Kaggle GPUs is the best free route; move to Modal when runs must be repeatable or need bigger GPUs. Owners of Apple silicon (MLX LM) or NVIDIA GPUs can train locally.
details: Together page did not state its data-privacy terms (opened); check before training on customer data. Kaggle weekly GPU quota numbers were not retrievable.

verify.note: $0.34/M and $4 minimum confirmed for small models; '$4 minimum on small models' understated that $4 is the floor for almost all models. Data-use terms still not on pricing page.
